strip_completeness: The entire numbered list of university-excused absences, from '### 1) Participation in an activity that is required for a class...' through '### 10) In accordance with Title IX of the Educational Amendments of 1972...', is institutional boilerplate and should be removed.
structural_coherence: The 'Course Grade' section presents grading components and points as a simple list, lacking a clear tabular structure for easy readability.

The 'Exam Dates' section includes non-exam-date information such as 'Homework: Every two weeks', 'Quiz: Short in-class quizzes are given randomly', and 'Spring Break (no classes will be held): March 9-13, 2026', which are out of place.

Under '### 6) Injury or illness...', the sub-headings '#### b)' and '#### c)' are at an inconsistent heading level compared to 'a)', and the bullet points under '#### b)' are not properly formatted or nested.
metadata_accuracy: CRN (Course Reference Number) is missing; only 'Section 600' is provided.

new_boilerplate: 1) Participation in an activity that is required for a class and appears on the university authorized activity list at https://stuactonline.tamu.edu/app/sponsauth/index
2) Death or major illness in a student's immediate family.
3) Illness of a dependent family member.
4) Participation in legal proceedings or administrative procedures that require a student's presence.
5) Religious holy day. NOTE: Prior notification is NOT required.
6) Injury or illness that is too severe or contagious for the student to attend class.
8) Mandatory admission interviews for professional or graduate school that cannot be rescheduled.
9) Mandatory participation as a student-athlete in NCAA-sanctioned competition.

10) In accordance with Title IX of the Educational Amendments of 1972, Texas A&M University shall treat pregnancy (childbirth, false pregnancy, termination of pregnancy and recovery therefrom) and related conditions as a justification for an excused absence for so long a period of time as is deemed medically necessary by the student's physician. Requests for excused absence related to pregnancy should be directed to the instructor.
proposals.reasoning: The numbered list of university-excused absences (items 1 through 10) represents institutional boilerplate text that is common across all university syllabi and should be removed to focus on course-specific content.
